title: MCP servers - the whole catalog in one place
intro: Informatica publishes five managed MCP servers exposing eleven actions between them. This section is the consolidated view; the same actions also appear inside each service section next to that product's API table. Source: the official April-2026 Getting Started with Informatica MCP Servers guide.

blocks.intro: Every action, regardless of what it does, is invoked as an HTTP POST to its server's single endpoint. The action name carries the intent. Each service section elsewhere in this document repeats the actions relevant to that product.

CORRECTED 2026-07-26 from the live tool schema: this action accepts NO arguments (properties={}), so do NOT pass conversation_id. blocks.title: How many MCP servers are there, really
rows: 5 - Address Verification, CDGC Metadata Search, Customer Identification, Data Provisioning, Job Management
AIAE April 2026 'Available MCP servers' p.7-8 enumerates exactly these five and no others. This is the authoritative catalog for that release.
...of those, exposed on a probed org
GET /public/core/v3/mcpServers returned a populated registry on one org listing 2; the same path 404s on another org entirely. Exposure is per-org, not per-product.
separate class, NOT in the five
Reached at <claire_api_url>/claire-orchestrator-ai-agent/api/v1/mcp. Appears as tools in the HOST app, not in the org's mcpServers registry - so counting it against the five is a category error.
Any MCP server you register in the host (claude mcp add) sits beside these. IDMC does not know about them.

Only the 5 managed servers are vendor-enumerated for April 2026. If someone cites more, ask which RELEASE and whether they are counting AI-agent servers or their own registrations. Re-read the Available MCP servers page before quoting a number to a customer - the roadmap is active.

notes.label: MCP is a small curated subset of REST, with two exceptions.
notes.text: Seven of the eleven actions are thin wrappers over a REST endpoint you could call directly, and in several cases REST is strictly more capable - raw Elasticsearch DSL instead of one search string, 1,000 addresses per call instead of one, full job history instead of a single job. The two genuine exceptions are asset lineage via get_asset_details and fuzzy identity match via search_master_record; neither has any REST equivalent on this platform.

notes.label: No MCP action authors a design-time asset.
notes.text: There is no mapping designer, no rule authoring and no business-entity modelling in the MCP catalog. The read/write boundary is identical to REST's, which is the clearest evidence that MCP sits on top of the same service APIs rather than beside them.

notes.label: Billing.
notes.text: MCP server usage is not separately metered during the AI Agent Engineering preview, but the shared servers call IDMC service APIs underneath and that consumption incurs IPUs at your normal service rate card. Budget MCP as the underlying service.

notes.label: Server availability is per-org.
notes.text: Of the five published servers, a live enumeration of one lab tenant found only two exposed on its MCP host. The documented catalog is the ceiling, not a guarantee.
